title: NpcPersonaSchedule
description: Per-NPC daily schedule for ambient simulation. Loaded at game-server boot. See README.md in this directory.

npcId.description: Must match Colyseus map.npcs[].id for main ambient NPCs.

persona.description: Persona label for worker prompts and tooling (e.g. scholar, farmer, chef).

segments.description: Half-open time segments [fromMinute, toMinute) covering the game day.

toMinute.description: Segment end (exclusive). If toMinute < fromMinute, segment wraps past midnight.

activityKey.description: Activity shown on HUD/nameplate. resting/idle skip movement; others may move per mobility.

zoneId.description: Namespaced zone where the NPC spends this segment, e.g. beginning-fields@v1:orchard.

mobility.description: wander = patrol zone; stationary = linger micro-wander near current cell (Stardew/AC); poi = walk to social POI then linger.
